selection: per seed minimum NEW validation MAE over baseline g5 and g6..g15; ties retain earliest. Benchmark NEVER selects models. Final held-out used once after selection freeze.
benchmark: same 128 prefixes x 3 seeds x 2 seats x 2 fixed opponents =1536 games per generation (768/opponent,128 independent opening groups). g5 and g6..15 all identical assignments. Repeated progress benchmark, not unknown test.
opening: prefix policy always frozen seed1751401 for ALL model seeds; 25% uniform legal and75% top16-uniform,8/10/12 plies. Exact prefix hashes frozen before training.
final: distinct fixed128 prefixes x3seeds x2seats x2opponents=1536 plus12 standard-start games; one evaluation after freeze
training: 2200 new games/generation:40% current selfplay,20% gen4,20% frozen g5,20% ridge. Current generation half loss mass, previous unique new data half; full shuffled epochs.
timing: epoch seconds measure training plus validation wall time, not pure GPU time. Generation/evaluation stage wall seconds separately recorded.
stop: 24h, nonfinite or resource anomaly; checkpoint before reporting; never indefinite
